prerequisites: Attainment of the second study section, with at least 42 ECTS points from the first study section.
Mastery of the object-oriented programming language Java

learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to develop small and medium-sized software systems.
Students are able to name the basic steps of software engineering.
Students are able to name existing quality models and their importance for software development.
Students are able to structuredly describe requirements for a software system.
Students are able to apply basic architectural principles to create their own software architectures.
Students are able to use selected UML diagrams for describing and documenting software.
Students are able to apply various test strategies to their own problem situations.
Students are able to name and apply basic procedure models for software development.
Students are able to practically apply the methods for developing software systems covered in the lecture.
Students are able to analyze, plan, and implement software systems.
Students are able to structuredly document requirements for a software product.
Students are able to describe software systems using UML diagrams.
Students are able to design and document software architectures.
Students are able to specify test cases and document test executions.

syllabus_topics: Requirements Engineering: Process, Stakeholders, System Context, Elicitation Methods, UML Diagrams

Software Architecture: Foundations, Architectural Principles, Component Architecture, Entity-Boundary-Controller, Design & Implementation, Implementation of Class Diagrams and State Machines, Coding Rules
Requirements Engineering: Stakeholders, System Context, Use-Cases, Class Diagrams, State Diagrams
Software Architecture & Design: Component Architecture, Entity-Boundary-Controller, Sequence Diagrams, Component Diagrams
Implementation: Implementation of a component architecture
assessment_rules: Successful completion of the internship (13.2) is a prerequisite for participation in the written examination (13.1). For successful completion of the internship, the solution and documentation of all 7 internship tasks are required.
